<h2 class="wp-block-heading" id="delivering-an-accurate-timely-and-secure-payroll-service-to-new-zealand-schools">Delivering an accurate, timely and secure payroll service to New Zealand schools.</h2>



<p></p>



<p><strong>Education Payroll is responsible for paying around 102,000 teachers and support staff in around 2,500 schools every fortnight. That’s approximately $294 million each pay period and $7.7 billion each year.</strong></p>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<p>The complexity of the schools’ payroll system is constantly evolving, and we work to make things as easy as possible for our customers.  <a rel="noreferrer noopener" href="https://educationpayroll.co.nz/edpay/" target="_blank">EdPay</a> ‒ our online portal for schools to submit payroll instructions ‒ is designed with and for schools.</p>



<p>We also provide phone advice and guidance to school administrators and principals, assess teachers’ qualifications and experience to set their correct salaries, administer third-party payments and manage overpayments.</p>



<p></p>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<p>It’s the combination of people, processes and cutting-edge technology that enables us to do this well. Our agile approach enables us to be flexible and adaptable, and respond to changes in education sector payroll requirements.</p>
